en: The postcard displays a sepia-toned photograph of an Italianate building with arched windows, labeled 'Casa Geromia via Larga.' A group of people stands on a quiet street. There is a visible postmark and an old postage stamp in the upper right corner, along with handwritten notes. The word 'Trento' appears in red in the top right along with a date (1903). There are printed and stamped messages in both red and purple, and a printed publisher mark at the bottom.
